description: Desktop AI IDE that uses Jev to route work to the right coding bot instead of guessing, and to triage incoming noise on wakeup.
how_used_jev: Jev picks the correct bot or declines rather than guessing; in wakeup triage it drops noise batches and keeps mixed batches in ~318ms, with critical items always surviving and the system failing open if Jev fails.
author: @LazyIDE

replaces.notes: positions itself against paid AI IDEs (Cursor-style) but author hasn't made a direct replacement claim yet - needs follow-up before scoring

benchmark.task: wakeup triage - mixed noise/signal batch classification

security_status.notes: explicitly fails open (lets routing through) if Jev fails - worth a Watchdog-lens note on what 'fails open' means for a routing decision
